Yes, you can.
(This is possible, since <<5234>> in the Monster Zone is Normal Monster, but it is also still a Trap Card.)

In this case, the <<5234>> is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone face-up since its Trap Effects are negated. It will not return to the Monster Zone at the end of the turn.

● <<12233>>'s ①st effect
● <<12078>>'s ①st effect
